notes.title: New Content - Mod Released
notes.content:
A mod is available for Knights of Grumthorr 2.

This mod includes new units and three base maps from which to create your own campaigns with the new units.

There are two factions with over a dozen new units in each faction.

Here are some screenshots:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085325/544c508ba0ff49bfef26d0485ebb70e3d390b5db.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085325/9562560c0c0e6a1c73e5023bef2c98abcc39f304.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085325/80b96c66ece50343717e7ee4002834868ba7a22b.png[/img]

The mod is available here:

[url=https://mattiesgames.com/assets/mod/oct27/media.zip]media.zip[/url]

notes.title: YouTube C#/SDL2 Game Code Details
notes.content:
On YouTube you can find the details of how to modify, edit and play around with the code for KoG2 in C# which uses SDL2 as its graphical and audio library.

Full details of the code and engine are described in this playlist on YouTube.

I hope you find it useful and enjoyable to play around with.

Thanks.
Matt

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ygm1LTt6gs&list=PLOA7XBr6vPr6CAEYbz_qqu62zaMJJYN4w]YouTube PlayList Link[/url]

notes.title: Knights of Grumthorr 2 Releasing March 30
notes.content:
Knights of Grumthorr 2 is releasing on March 30.

With many improved features over the original Knights of Grumthorr I hope you enjoy the game very much.
